```{r}
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("✗ ERROR during MICE initialization:\n")
  cat("  ", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Checking for problematic variables...\n")
  for(var in names(df_imp)) {
    var_class <- class(df_imp[[var]])
    n_unique <- length(unique(na.omit(df_imp[[var]])))
    n_missing <- sum(is.na(df_imp[[var]]))
    cat(sprintf("  %-30s: class = %-20s, unique = %3d, missing = %4d\n", 
                var, paste(var_class, collapse = ", "), n_unique, n_missing))
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  stop("MICE initialization failed. Review variable types above.")
})

method <- init$method
pred <- init$predictorMatrix

cat("✓ MICE initialized successfully\n\n")

# Remove constant variables from imputation
if(length(low_var_vars) > 0) {
  for(var in low_var_vars) {
    if(var %in% names(method)) {
      method[var] <- ""
    }
  }
  cat("  Excluded", length(low_var_vars), "constant/low-variance variables\n\n")
}

# Identify which variables actually have missing data
vars_with_missing <- names(colSums(is.na(df_imp)))[colSums(is.na(df_imp)) > 0]

cat("Setting imputation methods:\n\n")

# Set methods based on variable types - only for vars with missing data
for(var in continuous_in_data) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing && !(var %in% low_var_vars)) {
    method[var] <- "pmm"
  }
}
for(var in binary_in_data) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing && !(var %in% low_var_vars)) {
    method[var] <- "logreg"
  }
}
for(var in unordered_in_data) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing && !(var %in% low_var_vars)) {
    method[var] <- "polyreg"
  }
}
for(var in ordered_in_data) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing && !(var %in% low_var_vars)) {
    method[var] <- "polr"
  }
}

cat("Imputation method assignment:\n")
cat("  PMM (continuous):", sum(method == "pmm"), "variables\n")
cat("  Logreg (binary):", sum(method == "logreg"), "variables\n")
cat("  Polyreg (unordered):", sum(method == "polyreg"), "variables\n")
cat("  Polr (ordered):", sum(method == "polr"), "variables\n")
cat("  Not imputed:", sum(method == ""), "variables\n\n")

cat("Total variables to be imputed:", sum(method != ""), "\n")
cat("Variables without missing data (not imputed):", sum(method == ""), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# C3. DIAGNOSE AND FIX PROBLEMATIC ORDERED VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART C3: Diagnosing ordered factor variables for linear dependencies\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

ordered_vars_to_impute <- names(method)[method == "polr"]

if(length(ordered_vars_to_impute) > 0) {
  cat("Checking", length(ordered_vars_to_impute), "ordered factor variables:\n\n")
  
  for(var in ordered_vars_to_impute) {
    if(var %in% names(df_imp)) {
      non_na <- na.omit(df_imp[[var]])
      n_levels <- length(levels(df_imp[[var]]))
      n_unique <- length(unique(non_na))
      n_obs <- length(non_na)
      
      cat(sprintf("  %-30s: %d levels, %d unique values, %d obs\n", 
                  var, n_levels, n_unique, n_obs))
      
      if(n_levels < 2) {
        cat("    ⚠ WARNING: Less than 2 levels - cannot use polr\n")
        method[var] <- ""
        cat("    → Changed to: not imputed\n")
      } else if(n_unique < 2) {
        cat("    ⚠ WARNING: Less than 2 unique non-missing values\n")
        method[var] <- ""
        cat("    → Changed to: not imputed\n")
      } else if(n_obs < 10) {
        cat("    ⚠ WARNING: Very few non-missing observations\n")
      }
      
      # Reduce predictor matrix for ordered variables
      if(method[var] == "polr") {
        important_preds <- character()
        
        for(pred_var in names(df_imp)) {
          if(pred_var != var && pred[var, pred_var] == 1) {
            if(is.numeric(df_imp[[pred_var]])) {
              important_preds <- c(important_preds, pred_var)
            }
          }
        }
        
        if(length(important_preds) > 15) {
          keep_preds <- important_preds[1:15]
          for(p in names(df_imp)) {
            if(p != var && !p %in% keep_preds) {
              pred[var, p] <- 0
            }
          }
          cat("    → Reduced predictors from", length(important_preds), "to 15\n")
        }
      }
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
}

cat("Updated imputation method counts:\n")
cat("  PMM (continuous):", sum(method == "pmm"), "variables\n")
cat("  Logreg (binary):", sum(method == "logreg"), "variables\n")
cat("  Polyreg (unordered):", sum(method == "polyreg"), "variables\n")
cat("  Polr (ordered):", sum(method == "polr"), "variables\n")
cat("  Not imputed:", sum(method == ""), "variables\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. CONVERGENCE TEST WITH R-HAT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: CONVERGENCE DIAGNOSTICS WITH R-HAT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

calculate_rhat <- function(chain_vals_list, var_name) {
  numeric_chains <- lapply(chain_vals_list, function(x) {
    if(is.factor(x)) as.numeric(x) else x
  })
  
  numeric_chains <- lapply(numeric_chains, na.omit)
  if(any(sapply(numeric_chains, length) == 0)) return(NA)
  
  n <- length(numeric_chains[[1]])
  m <- length(numeric_chains)
  
  chain_means <- sapply(numeric_chains, mean)
  overall_mean <- mean(unlist(numeric_chains))
  
  B <- (n / (m - 1)) * sum((chain_means - overall_mean)^2)
  chain_vars <- sapply(numeric_chains, function(x) stats::var(x))
  W <- mean(chain_vars)
  
  var_plus <- ((n - 1) / n) * W + (1 / n) * B
  
  if(W > 1e-10 && is.finite(var_plus)) {
    return(sqrt(var_plus / W))
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

maxit_test_values <- c(5, 10,15, 20, 30)
convergence_results <- list()
n_chains <- 4
for(maxit_test in maxit_test_values) {
cat("Testing maxit =", maxit_test, "with", n_chains, "parallel chains...\n")
chain_results <- list()
failed_chains <- 0
for(chain in 1:n_chains) {
seed_val <- 12345 + chain * 1000
chain_imp <- tryCatch({
  suppressWarnings(
    mice(
      df_imp,
      m = 1,
      method = method,
      predictorMatrix = pred,
      maxit = maxit_test,
      seed = seed_val,
      printFlag = FALSE
    )
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("  ⚠ Chain", chain, "failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  failed_chains <<- failed_chains + 1
  return(NULL)
})

if(!is.null(chain_imp)) {
  chain_results[[chain]] <- complete(chain_imp, 1)
}
}
if(length(chain_results) < 2) {
cat("  ✗ Too many failed chains - skipping this maxit value\n\n")
convergence_results[[as.character(maxit_test)]] <- list(
maxit = maxit_test,
rhat_values = NA,
max_rhat = NA,
median_rhat = NA,
prop_converged = 0,
failed = TRUE
)
next
}
if(failed_chains > 0) {
cat("  ⚠", failed_chains, "chain(s) failed, continuing with", length(chain_results), "chains\n")
}
vars_to_check <- names(method)[method != ""]
rhat_values <- numeric(length(vars_to_check))
names(rhat_values) <- vars_to_check
for(var in vars_to_check) {
chain_vals <- lapply(chain_results, function(df) df[[var]])
rhat_values[var] <- calculate_rhat(chain_vals, var)
}
rhat_values_clean <- rhat_values[!is.na(rhat_values)]
if(length(rhat_values_clean) > 0) {
max_rhat <- max(rhat_values_clean)
median_rhat <- median(rhat_values_clean)
prop_converged <- mean(rhat_values_clean < 1.05)
cat(sprintf("  Max R-hat: %.4f | Median R-hat: %.4f | Converged: %.1f%%\n", 
            max_rhat, median_rhat, prop_converged * 100))

convergence_results[[as.character(maxit_test)]] <- list(
  maxit = maxit_test,
  rhat_values = rhat_values,
  max_rhat = max_rhat,
  median_rhat = median_rhat,
  prop_converged = prop_converged,
  failed = FALSE
)
} else {
cat("  ⚠ No valid R-hat values calculated\n")
convergence_results[[as.character(maxit_test)]] <- list(
maxit = maxit_test,
rhat_values = rhat_values,
max_rhat = NA,
median_rhat = NA,
prop_converged = 0,
failed = TRUE
)
}
cat("\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("CONVERGENCE SUMMARY ACROSS MAXIT VALUES\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

convergence_df <- data.frame(
  maxit = sapply(convergence_results, function(x) x$maxit),
  max_rhat = sapply(convergence_results, function(x) x$max_rhat),
  median_rhat = sapply(convergence_results, function(x) x$median_rhat),
  pct_converged = sapply(convergence_results, function(x) x$prop_converged * 100),
  failed = sapply(convergence_results, function(x) x$failed)
)

print(convergence_df)
cat("\n")

# FIXED: Proper subsetting
valid_results <- convergence_df[!convergence_df$failed & !is.na(convergence_df$max_rhat), ]

if(nrow(valid_results) > 0) {
  converged_rows <- valid_results[valid_results$max_rhat < 1.05, ]
  
  if(nrow(converged_rows) > 0) {
    optimal_maxit <- min(converged_rows$maxit)
    cat("✓ EXCELLENT CONVERGENCE achieved at maxit =", optimal_maxit, "\n")
    # FIXED: Proper subsetting
    cat("  Max R-hat:", round(converged_rows$max_rhat[converged_rows$maxit == optimal_maxit], 4), "\n")
  } else {
    # FIXED: Proper subsetting
    optimal_maxit <- valid_results$maxit[which.min(valid_results$max_rhat)]
    cat("⚠ No maxit achieved R-hat < 1.05, using best available: maxit =", optimal_maxit, "\n")
    # FIXED: Proper subsetting
    cat("  Max R-hat:", round(valid_results$max_rhat[valid_results$maxit == optimal_maxit], 4), "\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("✗ No valid convergence results - using default maxit = 20\n")
  optimal_maxit <- 20
}

cat("\n")

best_result <- convergence_results[[as.character(optimal_maxit)]]
if(!is.null(best_result) && !best_result$failed) {
  # FIXED: Proper subsetting
  rhat_vals <- best_result$rhat_values[!is.na(best_result$rhat_values)]
  
  if(length(rhat_vals) > 0) {
    cat("Top 10 variables by R-hat:\n")
    top_rhat <- head(sort(rhat_vals, decreasing = TRUE), 10)
    for(i in seq_along(top_rhat)) {
      status <- if(top_rhat[i] < 1.05) "✓" else if(top_rhat[i] < 1.1) "⚠" else "✗"
      cat(sprintf("  %s %2d. %-30s: R-hat = %.4f\n",
                  status, i, names(top_rhat)[i], top_rhat[i]))
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

cat("  Variables imputed:", sum(method != ""), "\n")
cat("  Variables not imputed (no missing data):", sum(method == ""), "\n\n")

cat("Checking imputed datasets:\n")

  }
}

if(all_complete) {
  cat("  ✓ All", imp_final$m, "imputed datasets are complete\n\n")
} else {
  cat("\n")
}

# Generate diagnostic plots

                         "n_health_conditions", "wdl_symptom_count")

                                           key_diagnostic_vars %in% names(method)[method != ""]]

if(length(key_diagnostic_vars) > 0) {
  pdf("imputation_diagnostics.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
  for(var in key_diagnostic_vars) {
    tryCatch({
      form <- as.formula(paste("~", var))
      densityplot(imp_final, form, main = paste("Density plot:", var))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  ⚠ Could not create density plot for", var, "\n")
    })
  }
  dev.off()
  cat("  ✓ Diagnostic plots saved to 'imputation_diagnostics.pdf'\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ℹ️  No suitable variables found for density plots\n\n")
}

cat("PART G: SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

saveRDS(imp_final, "imputed_data_item_level.rds")

saveRDS(convergence_results, "convergence_diagnostics.rds")
cat("✓ Saved convergence diagnostics: 'convergence_diagnostics.rds'\n")

imputation_metadata <- list(
  m = optimal_m,
  maxit = optimal_maxit,
  n_vars_imputed = sum(method != ""),

    sleep_aids = sleep_aid_vars[sleep_aid_vars %in% names(df_imp)],
    adverse_effects = adverse_vars[adverse_vars %in% names(df_imp)],
    withdrawal = wdl_vars[wdl_vars %in% names(df_imp)],
    dbas = dbas_vars[dbas_vars %in% names(df_imp)],
    bfi = bfi_vars[bfi_vars %in% names(df_imp)],
    surps = surps_vars[surps_vars %in% names(df_imp)],
    ciss = ciss_vars[ciss_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
  )
)

saveRDS(imputation_metadata, "imputation_metadata.rds")
```

## Subscale Creation

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# STEP 5: CREATE VALIDATED SUBSCALES WITH RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: 
#   - Create validated subscales using ALREADY-REVERSED items from imputation
#   - Calculate mean scores (standard in health research)
#   - Assess subscale-level reliability only
#   - No medication composites (not validated)
#==============================================================================

library(mice)
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 5: VALIDATED SUBSCALE CREATION & RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load imputed data
cat("Loading imputed data...\n")
imp_final <- readRDS("imputed_data_item_level.rds")

cat("✓ Loaded mice object with", imp_final$m, "imputations\n")
cat("  Variables:", ncol(imp_final$data), "\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(imp_final$data), "\n\n")

# Load original data to get outcome
var_reduction <- readRDS("imputation_preparation_reduced.rds")
outcome <- var_reduction$outcome
SIMOA_analysis <- var_reduction$analysis_data

cat("Outcome variable:", outcome, "\n\n")

cat("IMPORTANT: Using already-reversed items from imputation step\n")
cat("  • BFI: reserved, find_fault, lazy, relaxed, few_interests\n")
cat("  • SURPS: surps1, surps4, surps7, surps13, surps20, surps23\n")
cat("  → These items were reversed BEFORE imputation\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: SUBSCALE-LEVEL RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

#' Calculate subscale reliability and descriptive statistics
assess_subscale_reliability <- function(data, items, name, scale_range = NULL) {
  
  # Check if all items exist
  missing_items <- items[!items %in% names(data)]
  if(length(missing_items) > 0) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      floor_pct = NA,
      ceiling_pct = NA,
      n_complete = 0,
      status = "MISSING ITEMS",
      note = paste("Missing:", paste(missing_items, collapse = ", "))
    ))
  }
  
  # Extract item data
  item_data <- data %>% 
    select(all_of(items)) %>% 
    na.omit()
  
  n_complete <- nrow(item_data)
  
  # Need at least 10 cases for reliability analysis
  if(n_complete < 10) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      floor_pct = NA,
      ceiling_pct = NA,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      status = "INSUFFICIENT DATA",
      note = "< 10 complete cases"
    ))
  }
  
  # Convert to numeric matrix
  item_matrix <- as.data.frame(lapply(item_data, as.numeric))
  
  # Check variance
  item_sds <- sapply(item_matrix, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(any(item_sds == 0 | is.na(item_sds))) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      floor_pct = NA,
      ceiling_pct = NA,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      status = "NO VARIANCE",
      note = "One or more items have zero variance"
    ))
  }
  
  # Calculate Cronbach's alpha
  alpha_result <- tryCatch({
    psych::alpha(item_matrix, check.keys = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if(is.null(alpha_result)) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      floor_pct = NA,
      ceiling_pct = NA,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      status = "ALPHA FAILED",
      note = "Alpha calculation error"
    ))
  }
  
  # Extract reliability metrics
  alpha <- alpha_result$total$raw_alpha
  alpha_ci_lower <- alpha_result$feldt$lower.ci
  alpha_ci_upper <- alpha_result$feldt$upper.ci
  
  # Inter-item correlations
  cor_matrix <- cor(item_matrix, use = "complete.obs")
  cor_vector <- cor_matrix[lower.tri(cor_matrix)]
  mean_inter_item_r <- mean(cor_vector, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate subscale scores (MEAN of items)
  subscale_scores <- rowMeans(item_matrix, na.rm = FALSE)
  
  # Descriptive statistics
  mean_score <- mean(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_score <- sd(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_score <- min(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_score <- max(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Floor/ceiling effects (using scale range if provided)
  if(!is.null(scale_range)) {
    floor_val <- scale_range[1]
    ceiling_val <- scale_range[2]
  } else {
    floor_val <- min(sapply(item_matrix, min, na.rm = TRUE))
    ceiling_val <- max(sapply(item_matrix, max, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  
  floor_pct <- mean(subscale_scores == floor_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ceiling_pct <- mean(subscale_scores == ceiling_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  
  # Quality assessment
  status <- "GOOD"
  notes <- character()
  
  if(length(items) == 2) {
    notes <- c(notes, "2-item scale")
  }
  
  if(alpha < 0.60) {
    status <- "POOR RELIABILITY"
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("α = %.3f (< .60)", alpha))
  } else if(alpha < 0.70) {
    status <- "ACCEPTABLE"
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("α = %.3f (< .70)", alpha))
  }
  
  if(mean_inter_item_r < 0.15) {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("Low inter-item r (%.3f)", mean_inter_item_r))
  }
  
  if(floor_pct > 15) {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("Floor effect (%.1f%%)", floor_pct))
  }
  
  if(ceiling_pct > 15) {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("Ceiling effect (%.1f%%)", ceiling_pct))
  }
  
  note <- if(length(notes) > 0) paste(notes, collapse = "; ") else "No issues"
  
  return(list(
    name = name,
    n_items = length(items),
    alpha = alpha,
    alpha_ci_lower = alpha_ci_lower,
    alpha_ci_upper = alpha_ci_upper,
    mean_inter_item_r = mean_inter_item_r,
    mean = mean_score,
    sd = sd_score,
    min = min_score,
    max = max_score,
    floor_pct = floor_pct,
    ceiling_pct = ceiling_pct,
    n_complete = n_complete,
    status = status,
    note = note
  ))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: CREATE ALL SUBSCALES USING MEAN SCORES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: CREATE SUBSCALES (MEAN SCORES)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Convert to long format for manipulation
mids_long <- complete(imp_final, "long", include = TRUE)

cat("Creating subscales using MEAN scores...\n")
cat("(Standard in health research - interpretable on original scale)\n\n")

# Track created subscales
subscales_created <- list()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A.1. BFI-10: Big Five Personality (2 items per trait)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("A.1. Creating BFI-10 Subscales\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# Define BFI subscales using ALREADY-REVERSED items
bfi_subscales <- list(
  Extraversion = c("reserved", "outgoing"),
  Agreeableness = c("find_fault", "trusting"),
  Conscientiousness = c("lazy", "thorough"),
  Neuroticism = c("relaxed", "nervous"),
  Openness = c("few_interests", "imagination")
)

for(trait in names(bfi_subscales)) {
  items <- bfi_subscales[[trait]]
  
  # Check if items exist
  if(all(items %in% names(mids_long))) {
    var_name <- paste0("BFI_", trait)
    
    # Calculate mean score
    mids_long <- mids_long %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(!!var_name := mean(c(!!!syms(items)), na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    subscales_created$BFI[[trait]] <- list(
      variable = var_name,
      items = items,
      n_items = length(items)
    )
    
    cat("  ✓ Created:", var_name, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ✗ Skipped:", trait, "(missing items)\n")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Get first imputation
```
