```{r}
}
cat("\n")

cat("CISS SUBSCALES:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(dimension in names(subscales_created$CISS)) {
  subscale_info <- subscales_created$CISS[[dimension]]
  result <- assess_subscale_reliability(
    data = data_imp1,
    items = subscale_info$items,
    name = paste0("CISS: ", dimension),
    scale_range = c(1, 5)
  )
  reliability_results[[subscale_info$variable]] <- result
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s (n=%d items): α = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f], M = %.2f, SD = %.2f\n",
              dimension, result$n_items, result$alpha, result$alpha_ci_lower, 
              result$alpha_ci_upper, result$mean, result$sd))
}
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: CREATE SUMMARY TABLE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: SUMMARY TABLE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Build summary table
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Measure = character(),
  Subscale = character(),
  N_Items = integer(),
  Alpha = numeric(),
  CI_Lower = numeric(),
  CI_Upper = numeric(),
  Mean_r = numeric(),
  Mean = numeric(),
  SD = numeric(),
  Range_Min = numeric(),
  Range_Max = numeric(),
  Floor_Pct = numeric(),
  Ceiling_Pct = numeric(),
  N_Cases = integer(),
  Status = character(),
  Notes = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(var_name in names(reliability_results)) {
  result <- reliability_results[[var_name]]
  
  # Extract measure and subscale
  name_parts <- strsplit(result$name, ": ")[[1]]
  measure <- name_parts[1]
  subscale <- if(length(name_parts) > 1) name_parts[2] else "Total"
  
  summary_table <- rbind(summary_table, data.frame(
    Measure = measure,
    Subscale = subscale,
    N_Items = result$n_items,
    Alpha = result$alpha,
    CI_Lower = result$alpha_ci_lower,
    CI_Upper = result$alpha_ci_upper,
    Mean_r = result$mean_inter_item_r,
    Mean = result$mean,
    SD = result$sd,
    Range_Min = result$min,
    Range_Max = result$max,
    Floor_Pct = result$floor_pct,
    Ceiling_Pct = result$ceiling_pct,
    N_Cases = result$n_complete,
    Status = result$status,
    Notes = result$note,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

print(summary_table, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# Save summary table
write.csv(summary_table, "subscale_reliability_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: subscale_reliability_summary.csv\n\n")

# Identify any problematic subscales
problematic <- summary_table %>% filter(Status != "GOOD")
if(nrow(problematic) > 0) {
  cat("SUBSCALES WITH ISSUES:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(problematic)) {
    cat(sprintf("  • %s - %s: %s\n", 
                problematic$Measure[i], problematic$Subscale[i], problematic$Status[i]))
    cat(sprintf("    Notes: %s\n", problematic$Notes[i]))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# By-measure summary
cat("SUMMARY BY MEASURE:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
measure_summary <- summary_table %>%
  filter(Status == "GOOD" | Status == "ACCEPTABLE") %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Subscales = n(),
    Mean_Alpha = mean(Alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_Alpha = min(Alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Alpha = max(Alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(measure_summary, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: FINALIZE DATASET
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: FINALIZING DATASET\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Add outcome variable
if(outcome %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)) {
  mids_long[[outcome]] <- rep(SIMOA_analysis[[outcome]], times = imp_final$m + 1)
  cat("✓ Added outcome variable:", outcome, "\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠ Warning: Outcome variable not found in original data\n")
}

# Convert back to mids
imp_with_subscales <- as.mids(mids_long)

cat("✓ Converted back to mids object\n")
cat("  Total variables:", ncol(imp_with_subscales$data), "\n")
cat("  Subscales included:", n_total_subscales, "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: SAVE RESULTS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Save mids object with subscales
saveRDS(imp_with_subscales, "imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_data_with_subscales.rds\n")

# Save reliability results
saveRDS(list(
  subscales_created = subscales_created,
  reliability_results = reliability_results,
  summary_table = summary_table,
  measure_summary = measure_summary
), "subscale_reliability_assessment.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: subscale_reliability_assessment.rds\n")

# Save example complete dataset
example_data <- complete(imp_with_subscales, 1)
write.csv(example_data, "imputed_with_subscales_example.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_with_subscales_example.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: COMPREHENSIVE VALIDATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: COMPREHENSIVE VALIDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

validation_passed <- TRUE
validation_issues <- character()

cat("1. Checking subscale creation...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# Check all subscales exist in dataset
all_subscale_vars <- c()
for(measure in names(subscales_created)) {
  for(subscale in names(subscales_created[[measure]])) {
    var_name <- subscales_created[[measure]][[subscale]]$variable
    all_subscale_vars <- c(all_subscale_vars, var_name)
    
    if(var_name %in% names(imp_with_subscales$data)) {
      cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-30s exists\n", var_name))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  ✗ %-30s MISSING\n", var_name))
      validation_passed <- FALSE
      validation_issues <- c(validation_issues, paste("Missing subscale:", var_name))
    }
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("2. Checking subscale completeness across imputations...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(i in 1:imp_with_subscales$m) {
  imp_data <- complete(imp_with_subscales, i)
  
  missing_count <- 0
  for(var in all_subscale_vars) {
    if(var %in% names(imp_data)) {
      n_missing <- sum(is.na(imp_data[[var]]))
      if(n_missing > 0) {
        missing_count <- missing_count + n_missing
      }
    }
  }
  
  if(missing_count == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ Imputation %d: All subscales complete\n", i))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ Imputation %d: %d missing values in subscales\n", i, missing_count))
    validation_passed <- FALSE
    validation_issues <- c(validation_issues, 
                          paste("Imputation", i, "has", missing_count, "missing subscale values"))
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("3. Checking reliability assessment results...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

n_assessed <- length(reliability_results)
n_good <- sum(summary_table$Status == "GOOD")
n_acceptable <- sum(summary_table$Status == "ACCEPTABLE")
n_poor <- sum(summary_table$Status == "POOR RELIABILITY")

cat(sprintf("  Total subscales assessed: %d\n", n_assessed))
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Good reliability (α ≥ 0.70): %d\n", n_good))
cat(sprintf("  ⚠ Acceptable (0.60 ≤ α < 0.70): %d\n", n_acceptable))
if(n_poor > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ Poor reliability (α < 0.60): %d\n", n_poor))
  validation_issues <- c(validation_issues, paste(n_poor, "subscale(s) with poor reliability"))
}
cat("\n")

cat("4. Checking file outputs...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

files_to_check <- c(
  "imputed_data_with_subscales.rds",
  "subscale_reliability_assessment.rds",
  "subscale_reliability_summary.csv",
  "imputed_with_subscales_example.csv"
)

for(file in files_to_check) {
  if(file.exists(file)) {
    file_size <- file.info(file)$size
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-45s (%s KB)\n", file, round(file_size/1024, 1)))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ %-45s MISSING\n", file))
    validation_passed <- FALSE
    validation_issues <- c(validation_issues, paste("Missing file:", file))
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("5. Checking data integrity...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# Check that number of observations matches
n_obs_original <- nrow(imp_final$data)
n_obs_final <- nrow(imp_with_subscales$data)

if(n_obs_original == n_obs_final) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Observations preserved: %d cases\n", n_obs_final))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ Observation mismatch: %d → %d\n", n_obs_original, n_obs_final))
  validation_passed <- FALSE
  validation_issues <- c(validation_issues, "Number of observations changed")
}

# Check that outcome variable exists
if(outcome %in% names(imp_with_subscales$data)) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Outcome variable '%s' present\n", outcome))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ Outcome variable '%s' missing\n", outcome))
  validation_passed <- FALSE
  validation_issues <- c(validation_issues, "Outcome variable missing")
}

# Check number of imputations
if(imp_with_subscales$m == imp_final$m) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Number of imputations preserved: %d\n", imp_with_subscales$m))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ Imputation mismatch: %d → %d\n", imp_final$m, imp_with_subscales$m))
  validation_passed <- FALSE
  validation_issues <- c(validation_issues, "Number of imputations changed")
}
cat("\n")

cat("6. Sample data validation...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# Show example of subscale scores
example_subscales <- head(all_subscale_vars, 3)
example_imp1 <- complete(imp_with_subscales, 1)

cat("  Example subscale values (first 5 observations):\n")
for(var in example_subscales) {
  if(var %in% names(example_imp1)) {
    values <- head(example_imp1[[var]], 5)
    cat(sprintf("    %-30s: %s\n", var, 
                paste(sprintf("%.2f", values), collapse = ", ")))
  }
}
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL VALIDATION SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FINAL VALIDATION SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(validation_passed) {
  cat("✅ ALL VALIDATION CHECKS PASSED!\n\n")
  
  cat("SCRIPT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ %d subscales created successfully\n", n_total_subscales))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ All %d subscales assessed for reliability\n", n_assessed))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ %d subscales with good reliability (α ≥ 0.70)\n", n_good))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ All %d imputed datasets contain complete subscales\n", imp_with_subscales$m))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ All %d output files saved successfully\n", length(files_to_check)))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Data integrity maintained (%d observations)\n", n_obs_final))
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("📊 READY FOR ANALYSIS:\n")
  cat("  → Load 'imputed_data_with_subscales.rds' for statistical modeling\n")
  cat("  → Review 'subscale_reliability_summary.csv' for publication table\n")
  cat("  → All subscales use MEAN scores (interpretable on original scale)\n")
  cat("\n")
  
} else {
  cat("⚠️  VALIDATION ISSUES DETECTED:\n\n")
  
  for(i in seq_along(validation_issues)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %d. %s\n", i, validation_issues[i]))
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("ACTION REQUIRED:\n")
  cat("  → Review issues above before proceeding\n")
  cat("  → Check console output for detailed error messages\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("END OF STEP 5: SUBSCALE CREATION & VALIDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Print timestamp
cat("Completed:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")
```


## VSURF SELECTION 

## PERS ONLY

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 6: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY PREDICTORS ONLY)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Select important variables from personality domains only
# Strategy: Apply VSURF to personality block (BFI, SURPS, DBAS, CISS)
# Rationale: Focus on personality predictors, exclude DBAS_Total (sum of subscales)
# Output: Reduced set of personality predictors for logistic regression
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 6: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY ONLY)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load data
mids_with_subscales <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
subscales_info <- readRDS("subscales_created.rds")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra" 

# Get all personality subscales created
personality_subscales <- subscales_info$all_subscales

# Fix BFI variable names if needed (they should have BFI_ prefix)
personality_subscales <- ifelse(
  personality_subscales %in% c("Extraversion", "Agreeableness", "Conscientiousness", "Neuroticism", "Openness"),
  paste0("BFI_", personality_subscales),
  personality_subscales
)

cat("Loaded imputed data with subscales\n")
cat("  Outcome variable:", outcome_var, "\n")
cat("  Personality subscales:", length(personality_subscales), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══ CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK ═══\n\n")
cat("FOCUS: PERSONALITY PREDICTORS ONLY\n")
cat("  • BFI: Big Five personality traits\n")
cat("  • SURPS: Substance use risk profiles\n")
cat("  • DBAS: Dysfunctional beliefs about sleep (subscales only)\n")
cat("  • CISS: Coping styles\n\n")

cat("EXCLUSIONS:\n")
cat("  • DBAS_Total (sum of subscales - redundant)\n")
cat("  • Demographics (not included in this analysis)\n")
cat("  • Downstream variables (dependence, side effects)\n\n")

cat("VARIABLE SELECTION STRATEGY:\n")
cat("  • Use VSURF to reduce high-dimensional correlated personality block\n")
cat("  • Accept that correlated variables won't give consistent rankings\n")
cat("  • Goal: Modest number of predictors (~8-12 for n=400)\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# A. Define variable sets
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART A: Defining variable sets\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# PERSONALITY (high-dimensional correlated block - needs VSURF)
# Remove DBAS_Total if present (it's sum of subscales)
personality_for_selection <- personality_subscales[personality_subscales != "DBAS_Total"]

cat("PERSONALITY FOR SELECTION (", length(personality_for_selection), "):\n", sep = "")

# Count by domain
bfi_vars <- personality_for_selection[grepl("^(BFI_|Extraversion|Agreeableness|Conscientiousness|Neuroticism|Openness)", personality_for_selection)]
surps_vars <- personality_for_selection[grepl("^SURPS", personality_for_selection)]
dbas_vars <- personality_for_selection[grepl("^DBAS", personality_for_selection)]
ciss_vars <- personality_for_selection[grepl("^CISS", personality_for_selection)]

if(length(bfi_vars) > 0) {
  cat("  BFI (", length(bfi_vars), "): ", paste(bfi_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
if(length(surps_vars) > 0) {
  cat("  SURPS (", length(surps_vars), "): ", paste(surps_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
if(length(dbas_vars) > 0) {
  cat("  DBAS (", length(dbas_vars), "): ", paste(dbas_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
if(length(ciss_vars) > 0) {
  cat("  CISS (", length(ciss_vars), "): ", paste(ciss_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

# ==============================================================================
# B. Prepare data
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART B: Preparing data\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Extract first imputed dataset
data_complete <- complete(mids_with_subscales, 1)

cat("Checking variable availability...\n")

# Check available variables
available_personality <- personality_for_selection[personality_for_selection %in% names(data_complete)]

missing_personality <- personality_for_selection[!(personality_for_selection %in% names(data_complete))]

if(length(missing_personality) > 0) {
  cat("⚠ Missing personality variables:\n")
  for(var in missing_personality) cat("  • ", var, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("Available variables:\n")
cat("  Personality: ", length(available_personality), " of ", length(personality_for_selection), "\n\n", sep = "")

# Prepare personality data (for VSURF)
X_personality <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_personality)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Check if outcome exists
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found in dataset!")
}

# Prepare outcome
y_outcome <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove NAs
complete_idx <- !is.na(y_outcome)
X_personality <- X_personality[complete_idx, ]
y_outcome <- y_outcome[complete_idx]
y_outcome <- factor(y_outcome, levels = c(0, 1))
y_outcome <- droplevels(y_outcome)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X_personality), "\n")
cat("  Personality predictors:", ncol(X_personality), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y_outcome)
print(outcome_table)
cat("  Minority class %:", round(100 * min(outcome_table) / sum(outcome_table), 1), "\n\n")

# Check if we have enough data
if(nrow(X_personality) < 100) {
  stop("ERROR: Insufficient data (n < 100) for VSURF")
}

if(min(outcome_table) < 30) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: Low minority class count (", min(outcome_table), ") may affect RF performance\n\n", sep = "")
}

# ==============================================================================
# C. Run VSURF on personality block
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART C: Running VSURF on personality variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("VSURF THREE-STEP PROCESS:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING: Remove clearly irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION: Select variables for interpretation\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION: Minimal set for prediction\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF (this may take several minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(12345)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X_personality,
    y = y_outcome,
    ntree = 2000,           # Stable importance estimates
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X_personality)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR in VSURF:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 1)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# D. Extract results
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART D: Extracting results\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  cat("✗ VSURF FAILED - using fallback strategy\n\n")
  
  # Fallback: Use standard RF importance
  set.seed(12345)
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    x = X_personality,
    y = y_outcome,
    importance = TRUE,
    ntree = 2000
  )
  
  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  # Select top 8 personality variables (conservative for n=400)
  n_select <- min(8, nrow(importance_df))
  selected_personality <- importance_df$Variable[1:n_select]
  
  vsurf_threshold <- selected_personality
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_personality
  vsurf_prediction <- selected_personality[1:min(5, length(selected_personality))]
  
  cat("FALLBACK SELECTION (top", n_select, "by importance):\n")
  print(head(importance_df, n_select), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
} else {
  
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold <- names(X_personality)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X_personality)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction <- names(X_personality)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]
  
  cat("VSURF RESULTS:\n\n")
  
  cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING (", length(vsurf_threshold), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    cat("  Variables passing relevance threshold:\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables passed threshold\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION (", length(vsurf_interpretation), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
    cat("  → USE THESE for explanatory model\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables selected for interpretation\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION (", length(vsurf_prediction), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
    cat("  Minimal set for pure prediction:\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables selected for prediction\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Variable importance from final RF
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_vals <- vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(X_personality)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres],
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))
    
    cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (threshold step):\n")
    print(head(importance_df, 15), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  } else {
    # If no variables passed threshold, get importance from raw data
    set.seed(12345)
    rf_model <- randomForest(
      x = X_personality,
      y = y_outcome,
      importance = TRUE,
      ntree = 2000
    )
    
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))
    
    cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (from initial RF - threshold found none):\n")
    print(head(importance_df, 15), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# E. Create final variable set
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART E: Creating final variable set\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTION STRATEGY:\n")
cat("  • Use VSURF interpretation set from personality\n")
cat("  • Goal: ~8-12 personality predictors for n=400\n\n")

# Selected personality variables (interpretation set)
selected_personality <- vsurf_interpretation

# Handle case where VSURF selected nothing
if(length(selected_personality) == 0) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: VSURF selected 0 personality variables\n")
  cat("   Using top 8 from importance rankings as fallback\n\n")
  selected_personality <- importance_df$Variable[1:min(8, nrow(importance_df))]
}

# Final set is ONLY personality variables
final_variable_set <- selected_personality

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FINAL VARIABLE SET FOR LOGISTIC REGRESSION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("SELECTED PERSONALITY (", length(selected_personality), " - via VSURF):\n", sep = "")
if(length(selected_personality) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(selected_personality)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_personality[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("  ⚠ No personality variables selected\n")
}

cat("\nTOTAL PREDICTORS:", length(final_variable_set), "\n")
cat("Sample size:", nrow(X_personality), "\n")
cat("Events per variable:", round(min(outcome_table) / length(final_variable_set), 1), "\n\n")

if(length(final_variable_set) > 15) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: More than 15 predictors for n=", nrow(X_personality), " may lead to overfitting\n", sep = "")
  cat("   Consider further reducing personality variables\n\n")
} else if(length(final_variable_set) == 0) {
  stop("ERROR: No variables selected!")
} else {
  cat("✓ Variable count is appropriate for sample size\n\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# F. Group breakdown
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART F: Breakdown by personality domain\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

if(length(selected_personality) > 0) {
  # Classify personality variables
  personality_groups <- data.frame(
    Variable = selected_personality,
    Domain = case_when(
      grepl("^(BFI_|Extraversion|Agreeableness|Conscientiousness|Neuroticism|Openness)", selected_personality) ~ "BFI",
      grepl("^SURPS", selected_personality) ~ "SURPS",
      grepl("^DBAS", selected_personality) ~ "DBAS",
      grepl("^CISS", selected_personality) ~ "CISS",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(Domain, Variable)
  
  domain_summary <- personality_groups %>%
    count(Domain, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    mutate(
      N_Total = case_when(
        Domain == "BFI" ~ length(bfi_vars),
        Domain == "SURPS" ~ length(surps_vars),
        Domain == "DBAS" ~ length(dbas_vars),
        Domain == "CISS" ~ length(ciss_vars),
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      Percent = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1)
    )
  
  cat("Selection by personality domain:\n")
  print(domain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("Detailed breakdown:\n")
  for(domain in unique(personality_groups$Domain)) {
    vars_in_domain <- personality_groups %>% filter(Domain == domain)
    cat("  ", domain, " (", nrow(vars_in_domain), "):\n", sep = "")
    for(i in 1:nrow(vars_in_domain)) {
      cat("    • ", vars_in_domain$Variable[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠ No personality variables to summarize\n\n")
  domain_summary <- data.frame()
  personality_groups <- data.frame()
}

# ==============================================================================
# G. Visualizations
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART G: Creating visualizations\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# 1. Variable importance plot (personality only)
if(nrow(importance_df) > 0) {
  
  importance_plot_data <- importance_df %>%
    head(15) %>%
    mutate(
      Domain = case_when(
        grepl("^(BFI_|Extraversion|Agreeableness|Conscientiousness|Neuroticism|Openness)", Variable) ~ "BFI",
        grepl("^SURPS", Variable) ~ "SURPS",
        grepl("^DBAS", Variable) ~ "DBAS",
        grepl("^CISS", Variable) ~ "CISS",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Selected = Variable %in% selected_personality
    )
  
  p_importance <- ggplot(importance_plot_data, 
                         aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), 
                             y = Importance,
                             fill = Domain,
                             alpha = Selected)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.4),
                       name = "VSURF Selected") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "Variable Importance - Personality Predictors",
      subtitle = paste("VSURF selected", length(selected_personality), "of", ncol(X_personality), "variables for interpretation"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_personality_importance.png", 
         plot = p_importance, 
         width = 10, 
         height = 8, 
         dpi = 300)
  
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_importance.png\n")
}

# 2. Selection by domain plot
if(nrow(domain_summary) > 0) {
  p_domain <- ggplot(domain_summary, 
                     aes(x = reorder(Domain, N_Selected), 
                         y = N_Selected,
                         fill = Domain)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(N_Selected, "/", N_Total, " (", Percent, "%)")),
              hjust = -0.1, size = 4) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
    labs(
      title = "VSURF Selection by Personality Domain",
      subtitle = "Number of variables selected for interpretation",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variables Selected"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11)
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_selection_by_domain.png", 
         plot = p_domain, 
         width = 10, 
         height = 6, 
         dpi = 300)
  
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_selection_by_domain.png\n")
}

cat("\n")

# ==============================================================================
# H. Save results
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART H: Saving results\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

vsurf_output <- list(
  # VSURF object
  vsurf_object = vsurf_result,
  
  # Variable sets
  personality_selected = selected_personality,
  final_variable_set = final_variable_set,
  
  # VSURF selections
  vsurf_threshold = vsurf_threshold,
  vsurf_interpretation = vsurf_interpretation,
  vsurf_prediction = vsurf_prediction,
  
  # Importance
  importance_rankings = importance_df,
  
  # Summary
  domain_summary = domain_summary,
  personality_breakdown = if(length(selected_personality) > 0) personality_groups else data.frame(),
  
  # Metadata
  outcome_var = outcome_var,
  n_observations = nrow(X_personality),
  n_personality_input = ncol(X_personality),
  n_personality_selected = length(selected_personality),
  n_total_predictors = length(final_variable_set),
  time_taken = time_taken
)

saveRDS(vsurf_output, "VSURF_results.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_results.rds\n")

saveRDS(final_variable_set, "VSURF_recommended_variables.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_recommended_variables.rds\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# I. Key messages
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("KEY DECISIONS:\n\n")

cat("1. PERSONALITY ONLY:\n")
cat("   • Applied VSURF to personality block only\n")
cat("   • Selected:", length(selected_personality), "of", ncol(X_personality), "variables\n")
cat("   • Used 'interpretation' set (more inclusive than 'prediction')\n")
cat("   • DBAS_Total excluded (redundant with subscales)\n\n")

cat("2. EXCLUDED VARIABLES:\n")
cat("   • Demographics (not included in this analysis)\n")
cat("   • DBAS_Total (sum of subscales)\n")
cat("   • Downstream variables (dependence, side effects)\n\n")

cat("3. FINAL MODEL:\n")
cat("   • Total predictors:", length(final_variable_set), "\n")
cat("   • Sample size:", nrow(X_personality), "\n")
cat("   • Events per variable:", round(min(outcome_table) / length(final_variable_set), 1), "\n")
cat("   • Appropriate for explanatory logistic regression\n\n")

cat("IMPORTANT NOTES:\n\n")

cat("• VSURF may give different results with different seeds\n")
cat("  → This is EXPECTED when variables are correlated\n")
cat("  → Not a bug, just algorithm shuffling among near-equivalents\n\n")

cat("• Focus on conceptual interpretation, not strict rankings\n")
cat("  → Similar constructs carry overlapping information\n\n")

cat("NEXT STEPS:\n")
cat("  1. Review visualizations\n")
cat("  2. Proceed to logistic regression with selected personality variables\n")
cat("  3. Report: 'Personality variables selected using VSURF to reduce\n")
cat("     dimensionality while maintaining interpretability'\n\n")

cat("✓ Ready for downstream analysis!\n\n")
```





## CLIN ONLY

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 6B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (CLINICAL PREDICTORS ONLY)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Select important clinical/health variables
# Strategy: Apply VSURF to clinical block
# Rationale: Identify key health and medication factors predicting BZRA cessation
# Output: Reduced set of clinical predictors for logistic regression
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 6B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (CLINICAL VARIABLES)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load data
mids_with_subscales <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"  # Update if different

cat("Loaded imputed data\n")
cat("  Outcome variable:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══ CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK ═══\n\n")
cat("FOCUS: CLINICAL/HEALTH PREDICTORS\n")
cat("  • General health status\n")
cat("  • Health condition counts (physical, mental, sleep)\n")
cat("  • Medication burden\n")
cat("  • Sleep aids usage\n")
cat("  • Adverse effects and safety concerns\n")
cat("  • NOTE: Withdrawal variables EXCLUDED (temporal ordering)\n\n")

cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  • These variables exist BEFORE/DURING use (not during cessation)\n")
cat("  • Withdrawal variables excluded (temporal ordering issue)\n")
cat("  • May predict ability/willingness to stop\n")
cat("  • Includes both objective (counts) and subjective (concerns) measures\n\n")

cat("VARIABLE SELECTION STRATEGY:\n")
cat("  • Use VSURF to identify most important clinical predictors\n")
cat("  • Handle potentially correlated variables (e.g., condition counts)\n")
cat("  • Goal: ~8-12 clinical predictors\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# A. Define variable sets
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART A: Defining clinical variable sets\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Clinical variables
clin_vars <- c("gen_health", "med_quant", "osss_3_score", "phq2_score")

# Condition counts
count_vars <- c("n_health_conditions", "n_physical_conditions", 
                "n_ment_conditions", "n_sleep_conditions")

# Medication burden
med_burden_vars <- c("med_burden_1", "med_burden2", "medburden_3", "med_burden_4")

# Sleep aids
sleep_aid_vars <- c("alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep")

# Adverse effects items
adverse_vars <- c(paste0("side_effects_", 1:4), 
                  paste0("safety_", 1:4), 
                  paste0("adls_", 1:2), 
                  paste0("dependence_", 1:3))

# Withdrawal - EXCLUDED (these are consequences of stopping, not predictors)
# wdl_vars <- c("stop_wdl_exp_combined", "wdl_symptom_count")

# Combine all clinical variables (EXCLUDING withdrawal)
clinical_for_selection <- c(clin_vars, count_vars, med_burden_vars, 
                            sleep_aid_vars, adverse_vars)

cat("CLINICAL VARIABLE CATEGORIES:\n\n")
cat("  Basic Clinical (", length(clin_vars), "):\n    ", 
    paste(clin_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  Condition Counts (", length(count_vars), "):\n    ", 
    paste(count_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  Medication Burden (", length(med_burden_vars), "):\n    ", 
    paste(med_burden_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  Sleep Aids (", length(sleep_aid_vars), "):\n    ", 
    paste(sleep_aid_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  Adverse Effects (", length(adverse_vars), "):\n    ", 
    paste(adverse_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("EXCLUDED FROM ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("  Withdrawal variables (consequences of stopping, not predictors):\n")
cat("    • stop_wdl_exp_combined\n")
cat("    • wdl_symptom_count\n\n")

cat("TOTAL CLINICAL VARIABLES:", length(clinical_for_selection), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# B. Prepare data
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART B: Preparing data\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Extract first imputed dataset
data_complete <- complete(mids_with_subscales, 1)

cat("Checking variable availability...\n\n")

# Check available variables by category
check_availability <- function(vars, category_name) {
  available <- vars[vars %in% names(data_complete)]
  missing <- vars[!(vars %in% names(data_complete))]
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d/%d present\n", category_name, 
              length(available), length(vars)))
  
  if(length(missing) > 0) {
    cat("    Missing:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  return(available)
}

clin_available <- check_availability(clin_vars, "Basic Clinical")
count_available <- check_availability(count_vars, "Condition Counts")
med_burden_available <- check_availability(med_burden_vars, "Medication Burden")
sleep_available <- check_availability(sleep_aid_vars, "Sleep Aids")
adverse_available <- check_availability(adverse_vars, "Adverse Effects")

cat("\n")

# Combine all available variables (NO withdrawal)
available_clinical <- c(clin_available, count_available, med_burden_available,
                        sleep_available, adverse_available)

if(length(available_clinical) == 0) {
  stop("ERROR: No clinical variables found in dataset!")
}

cat("SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  Total clinical variables requested:", length(clinical_for_selection), "\n")
cat("  Available in dataset:", length(available_clinical), "\n")
cat("  Missing:", length(clinical_for_selection) - length(available_clinical), "\n\n")

# Prepare clinical data (for VSURF)
X_clinical <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_clinical)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Check if outcome exists
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found in dataset!")
}

# Prepare outcome
y_outcome <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove NAs
complete_idx <- !is.na(y_outcome)
X_clinical <- X_clinical[complete_idx, ]
y_outcome <- y_outcome[complete_idx]
y_outcome <- factor(y_outcome, levels = c(0, 1))
y_outcome <- droplevels(y_outcome)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X_clinical), "\n")
cat("  Clinical predictors:", ncol(X_clinical), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y_outcome)
print(outcome_table)
cat("  Minority class %:", round(100 * min(outcome_table) / sum(outcome_table), 1), "\n\n")

# Check if we have enough data
if(nrow(X_clinical) < 100) {
  stop("ERROR: Insufficient data (n < 100) for VSURF")
}

if(ncol(X_clinical) == 0) {
  stop("ERROR: No clinical variables available after filtering")
}

if(min(outcome_table) < 30) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: Low minority class count (", min(outcome_table), 
      ") may affect RF performance\n\n", sep = "")
}

# ==============================================================================
# C. Run VSURF on clinical variables
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART C: Running VSURF on clinical variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("VSURF THREE-STEP PROCESS:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING: Remove clearly irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION: Select variables for interpretation\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION: Minimal set for prediction\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF (this may take several minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(12345)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X_clinical,
    y = y_outcome,
    ntree = 2000,
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X_clinical)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR in VSURF:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 1)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# D. Extract results
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART D: Extracting results\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  cat("✗ VSURF FAILED - using fallback strategy\n\n")
  
  # Fallback: Use standard RF importance
  set.seed(12345)
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    x = X_clinical,
    y = y_outcome,
    importance = TRUE,
    ntree = 2000
  )
  
  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  # Select top 10 clinical variables
  n_select <- min(10, nrow(importance_df))
  selected_clinical <- importance_df$Variable[1:n_select]
  
  vsurf_threshold <- selected_clinical
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_clinical
  vsurf_prediction <- selected_clinical[1:min(5, length(selected_clinical))]
  
  cat("FALLBACK SELECTION (top", n_select, "by importance):\n")
  print(head(importance_df, n_select), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
} else {
  
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold <- names(X_clinical)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X_clinical)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction <- names(X_clinical)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]
  
  cat("VSURF RESULTS:\n\n")
  
  cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING (", length(vsurf_threshold), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    cat("  Variables passing relevance threshold:\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables passed threshold\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION (", length(vsurf_interpretation), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
    cat("  → USE THESE for explanatory model\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables selected for interpretation\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION (", length(vsurf_prediction), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
    cat("  Minimal set for pure prediction:\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables selected for prediction\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Variable importance from final RF
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_vals <- vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(X_clinical)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres],
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))
    
    cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (threshold step):\n")
    print(head(importance_df, 20), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  } else {
    # If no variables passed threshold, get importance from raw data
    set.seed(12345)
    rf_model <- randomForest(
      x = X_clinical,
      y = y_outcome,
      importance = TRUE,
      ntree = 2000
    )
    
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))
    
    cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (from initial RF - threshold found none):\n")
    print(head(importance_df, 20), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# E. Create final variable set
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART E: Creating final variable set\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTION STRATEGY:\n")
cat("  • Use VSURF interpretation set from clinical variables\n")
cat("  • Goal: ~8-12 clinical predictors\n\n")

# Selected clinical variables (interpretation set)
selected_clinical <- vsurf_interpretation

# Handle case where VSURF selected nothing
if(length(selected_clinical) == 0) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: VSURF selected 0 clinical variables\n")
  cat("   Using top 10 from importance rankings as fallback\n\n")
  selected_clinical <- importance_df$Variable[1:min(10, nrow(importance_df))]
}

# Final set is ONLY clinical variables
final_variable_set <- selected_clinical

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FINAL VARIABLE SET FOR LOGISTIC REGRESSION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("SELECTED CLINICAL (", length(selected_clinical), " - via VSURF):\n", sep = "")
if(length(selected_clinical) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(selected_clinical)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_clinical[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("  ⚠ No clinical variables selected\n")
}

cat("\nTOTAL PREDICTORS:", length(final_variable_set), "\n")
cat("Sample size:", nrow(X_clinical), "\n")
cat("Events per variable:", round(min(outcome_table) / length(final_variable_set), 1), "\n\n")

if(length(final_variable_set) > 15) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: More than 15 predictors for n=", nrow(X_clinical), 
      " may lead to overfitting\n", sep = "")
  cat("   Consider further reducing clinical variables\n\n")
} else if(length(final_variable_set) == 0) {
  stop("ERROR: No variables selected!")
} else {
  cat("✓ Variable count is appropriate for sample size\n\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# F. Group breakdown by category
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART F: Breakdown by clinical category\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

if(length(selected_clinical) > 0) {
  # Classify clinical variables
  clinical_groups <- data.frame(
    Variable = selected_clinical,
    Category = case_when(
      selected_clinical %in% clin_vars ~ "Basic Clinical",
      selected_clinical %in% count_vars ~ "Condition Counts",
      selected_clinical %in% med_burden_vars ~ "Medication Burden",
      selected_clinical %in% sleep_aid_vars ~ "Sleep Aids",
      selected_clinical %in% adverse_vars ~ "Adverse Effects",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(Category, Variable)
  
  category_summary <- clinical_groups %>%
    count(Category, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    mutate(
      N_Total = case_when(
        Category == "Basic Clinical" ~ length(clin_available),
        Category == "Condition Counts" ~ length(count_available),
        Category == "Medication Burden" ~ length(med_burden_available),
        Category == "Sleep Aids" ~ length(sleep_available),
        Category == "Adverse Effects" ~ length(adverse_available),
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      Percent = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1)
    )
  
  cat("Selection by clinical category:\n")
  print(category_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("Detailed breakdown:\n")
  for(category in unique(clinical_groups$Category)) {
    vars_in_cat <- clinical_groups %>% filter(Category == category)
    cat("  ", category, " (", nrow(vars_in_cat), "):\n", sep = "")
    for(i in 1:nrow(vars_in_cat)) {
      cat("    • ", vars_in_cat$Variable[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠ No clinical variables to summarize\n\n")
  category_summary <- data.frame()
  clinical_groups <- data.frame()
}

# ==============================================================================
# G. Visualizations
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART G: Creating visualizations\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# 1. Variable importance plot
if(nrow(importance_df) > 0) {
  
  importance_plot_data <- importance_df %>%
    head(20) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        Variable %in% clin_vars ~ "Basic Clinical",
        Variable %in% count_vars ~ "Condition Counts",
        Variable %in% med_burden_vars ~ "Medication Burden",
        Variable %in% sleep_aid_vars ~ "Sleep Aids",
        Variable %in% adverse_vars ~ "Adverse Effects",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Selected = Variable %in% selected_clinical
    )
  
  p_importance <- ggplot(importance_plot_data, 
                         aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), 
                             y = Importance,
                             fill = Category,
                             alpha = Selected)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.4),
                       name = "VSURF Selected") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "Variable Importance - Clinical Predictors",
      subtitle = paste("VSURF selected", length(selected_clinical), 
                      "of", ncol(X_clinical), "variables for interpretation"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_clinical_importance.png", 
         plot = p_importance, 
         width = 10, 
         height = 10, 
         dpi = 300)
  
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_importance.png\n")
}

# 2. Selection by category plot
if(nrow(category_summary) > 0) {
  p_category <- ggplot(category_summary, 
                       aes(x = reorder(Category, N_Selected), 
                           y = N_Selected,
                           fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(N_Selected, "/", N_Total, " (", Percent, "%)")),
              hjust = -0.1, size = 4) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
    labs(
      title = "VSURF Selection by Clinical Category",
      subtitle = "Number of variables selected for interpretation",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variables Selected"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11)
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_clinical_selection_by_category.png", 
         plot = p_category, 
         width = 10, 
         height = 6, 
         dpi = 300)
  
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_selection_by_category.png\n")
}

cat("\n")

# ==============================================================================
# H. Save results
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART H: Saving results\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

vsurf_output <- list(
  # VSURF object
  vsurf_object = vsurf_result,
  
  # Variable sets
  clinical_selected = selected_clinical,
  final_variable_set = final_variable_set,
  
  # VSURF selections
  vsurf_threshold = vsurf_threshold,
  vsurf_interpretation = vsurf_interpretation,
  vsurf_prediction = vsurf_prediction,
  
  # Importance
  importance_rankings = importance_df,
  
  # Summary
  category_summary = category_summary,
  clinical_breakdown = if(length(selected_clinical) > 0) clinical_groups else data.frame(),
  
  # Metadata
  outcome_var = outcome_var,
  n_observations = nrow(X_clinical),
  n_clinical_input = ncol(X_clinical),
  n_clinical_selected = length(selected_clinical),
  n_total_predictors = length(final_variable_set),
  time_taken = time_taken
)

saveRDS(vsurf_output, "VSURF_clinical_results.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_results.rds\n")

saveRDS(final_variable_set, "VSURF_clinical_recommended_variables.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_recommended_variables.rds\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# I. Key messages
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF CLINICAL VARIABLE SELECTION COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("KEY DECISIONS:\n\n")

cat("1. CLINICAL VARIABLES ONLY:\n")
cat("   • Applied VSURF to clinical/health block\n")
cat("   • Selected:", length(selected_clinical), "of", ncol(X_clinical), "variables\n")
cat("   • Used 'interpretation' set (more inclusive than 'prediction')\n\n")

cat("2. VARIABLE CATEGORIES INCLUDED:\n")
cat("   • Basic clinical (health status, medications, support)\n")
cat("   • Condition counts (physical, mental, sleep)\n")
cat("   • Medication burden\n")
cat("   • Sleep aids usage\n")
cat("   • Adverse effects and safety concerns\n\n")

cat("   EXCLUDED (temporal/causal concerns):\n")
cat("   • Withdrawal variables (occur during stopping attempt)\n\n")

cat("3. FINAL MODEL:\n")
cat("   • Total predictors:", length(final_variable_set), "\n")
cat("   • Sample size:", nrow(X_clinical), "\n")
cat("   • Events per variable:", round(min(outcome_table) / length(final_variable_set), 1), "\n")
cat("   • Appropriate for explanatory logistic regression\n\n")

cat("IMPORTANT NOTES:\n\n")

cat("• VSURF provides three sets of variables:\n")
cat("  → INTERPRETATION (", length(vsurf_interpretation), "): For explanatory models\n", sep = "")
cat("  → PREDICTION (", length(vsurf_prediction), "): For pure prediction\n", sep = "")
cat("  → THRESHOLD (", length(vsurf_threshold), "): All relevant variables\n\n", sep = "")

cat("• Clinical variables predict stopping behavior:\n")
cat("  → Adverse effects experienced DURING use can motivate cessation\n")
cat("  → Health conditions and medication burden provide context\n")
cat("  → These are legitimate predictors, not consequences of stopping\n\n")

cat("• Withdrawal variables were EXCLUDED:\n")
cat("  → Occur during/after cessation attempt (not predictors OF stopping)\n")
cat("  → Would create temporal/causal confusion\n")
cat("  → Should be analyzed as mediators or outcomes, not predictors\n\n")

cat("NEXT STEPS:\n")
cat("  1. Review visualizations\n")
cat("  2. Consider combining with personality variables\n")
cat("  3. Proceed to logistic regression\n")
cat("  4. Note: Withdrawal variables excluded due to temporal ordering\n")
cat("     (they occur DURING stopping, not before the decision)\n\n")

cat("✓ Ready for downstream analysis!\n\n")
```


## CLIN + PERS

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 6C: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (COMBINED PERSONALITY + CLINICAL)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Apply VSURF to combined personality and clinical variables
# Strategy: Let variables compete across domains to find optimal set
# Rationale: Sensitivity analysis - compare to domain-specific VSURF results
# Output: Reduced set when variables compete directly
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 6C: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (COMBINED APPROACH)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load data
mids_with_subscales <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
subscales_info <- readRDS("subscales_created.rds")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

cat("Loaded imputed data with subscales\n")
cat("  Outcome variable:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══ CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK ═══\n\n")
cat("SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: COMBINED VARIABLE SELECTION\n")
cat("  • Personality traits (BFI, SURPS, DBAS, CISS)\n")
cat("  • Clinical/health variables (conditions, medications, adverse effects)\n")
cat("  • Variables compete ACROSS domains for selection\n\n")

cat("COMPARISON TO PRIMARY ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("  Primary: Separate VSURF for each domain → ensures representation\n")
cat("  Sensitivity: Combined VSURF → optimal set regardless of domain\n\n")

cat("RESEARCH QUESTIONS:\n")
cat("  1. Do similar variables emerge when competing across domains?\n")
cat("  2. Does one domain dominate the selection?\n")
cat("  3. Is the combined approach more parsimonious?\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# A. Define variable sets
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART A: Defining combined variable set\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Get personality subscales (fix BFI naming)
personality_subscales <- subscales_info$all_subscales

# Fix BFI variable names if needed
personality_subscales <- ifelse(
  personality_subscales %in% c("Extraversion", "Agreeableness", "Conscientiousness", 
                                "Neuroticism", "Openness"),
  paste0("BFI_", personality_subscales),
  personality_subscales
)

# Remove DBAS_Total
personality_for_selection <- personality_subscales[personality_subscales != "DBAS_Total"]

# Clinical variables (excluding withdrawal)
clin_vars <- c("gen_health", "med_quant", "osss_3_score", "phq2_score")
count_vars <- c("n_health_conditions", "n_physical_conditions", 
                "n_ment_conditions", "n_sleep_conditions")
med_burden_vars <- c("med_burden_1", "med_burden2", "medburden_3", "med_burden_4")
sleep_aid_vars <- c("alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep")
adverse_vars <- c(paste0("side_effects_", 1:4), 
                  paste0("safety_", 1:4), 
                  paste0("adls_", 1:2), 
                  paste0("dependence_", 1:3))

clinical_for_selection <- c(clin_vars, count_vars, med_burden_vars, 
                            sleep_aid_vars, adverse_vars)

# COMBINE personality and clinical
combined_for_selection <- c(personality_for_selection, clinical_for_selection)

cat("VARIABLE BREAKDOWN:\n\n")

# Personality breakdown
bfi_vars <- personality_for_selection[grepl("^(BFI_|Extraversion|Agreeableness|Conscientiousness|Neuroticism|Openness)", personality_for_selection)]
surps_vars <- personality_for_selection[grepl("^SURPS", personality_for_selection)]
dbas_vars <- personality_for_selection[grepl("^DBAS", personality_for_selection)]
ciss_vars <- personality_for_selection[grepl("^CISS", personality_for_selection)]

cat("PERSONALITY VARIABLES (", length(personality_for_selection), "):\n", sep = "")
if(length(bfi_vars) > 0) {
  cat("  BFI (", length(bfi_vars), "): ", paste(bfi_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
if(length(surps_vars) > 0) {
  cat("  SURPS (", length(surps_vars), "): ", paste(surps_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
if(length(dbas_vars) > 0) {
  cat("  DBAS (", length(dbas_vars), "): ", paste(dbas_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
if(length(ciss_vars) > 0) {
  cat("  CISS (", length(ciss_vars), "): ", paste(ciss_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("CLINICAL VARIABLES (", length(clinical_for_selection), "):\n", sep = "")
cat("  Basic Clinical (", length(clin_vars), "): ", paste(clin_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Condition Counts (", length(count_vars), "): ", paste(count_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Medication Burden (", length(med_burden_vars), "): ", paste(med_burden_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Sleep Aids (", length(sleep_aid_vars), "): ", paste(sleep_aid_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Adverse Effects (", length(adverse_vars), "): ", paste(adverse_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("EXCLUDED:\n")
cat("  • DBAS_Total (redundant with subscales)\n")
cat("  • Withdrawal variables (temporal ordering issues)\n\n")

cat("TOTAL COMBINED VARIABLES:", length(combined_for_selection), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# B. Prepare data
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART B: Preparing data\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Extract first imputed dataset
data_complete <- complete(mids_with_subscales, 1)

cat("Checking variable availability...\n\n")

# Check available variables
available_combined <- combined_for_selection[combined_for_selection %in% names(data_complete)]
missing_combined <- combined_for_selection[!(combined_for_selection %in% names(data_complete))]

if(length(missing_combined) > 0) {
  cat("⚠ Missing variables:\n")
  for(var in missing_combined) cat("  • ", var, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n")
}

# Count by domain
available_personality <- available_combined[available_combined %in% personality_for_selection]
available_clinical <- available_combined[available_combined %in% clinical_for_selection]

cat("Available variables:\n")
cat("  Personality: ", length(available_personality), " of ", length(personality_for_selection), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Clinical: ", length(available_clinical), " of ", length(clinical_for_selection), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  TOTAL: ", length(available_combined), " of ", length(combined_for_selection), "\n\n", sep = "")

# Prepare data for VSURF
X_combined <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_combined)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Check if outcome exists
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found in dataset!")
}

# Prepare outcome
y_outcome <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove NAs
complete_idx <- !is.na(y_outcome)
X_combined <- X_combined[complete_idx, ]
y_outcome <- y_outcome[complete_idx]
y_outcome <- factor(y_outcome, levels = c(0, 1))
y_outcome <- droplevels(y_outcome)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X_combined), "\n")
cat("  Combined predictors:", ncol(X_combined), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y_outcome)
print(outcome_table)
cat("  Minority class %:", round(100 * min(outcome_table) / sum(outcome_table), 1), "\n\n")

# Check if we have enough data
if(nrow(X_combined) < 100) {
  stop("ERROR: Insufficient data (n < 100) for VSURF")
}

if(min(outcome_table) < 30) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: Low minority class count (", min(outcome_table), 
      ") may affect RF performance\n\n", sep = "")
}

# ==============================================================================
# C. Run VSURF on combined variables
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART C: Running VSURF on combined personality + clinical variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("VSURF THREE-STEP PROCESS:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING: Remove clearly irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION: Select variables for interpretation\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION: Minimal set for prediction\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF on", ncol(X_combined), "variables (this may take several minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(12345)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X_combined,
    y = y_outcome,
    ntree = 2000,
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X_combined)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR in VSURF:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 1)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# D. Extract results
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART D: Extracting results\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  cat("✗ VSURF FAILED - using fallback strategy\n\n")
  
  # Fallback: Use standard RF importance
  set.seed(12345)
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    x = X_combined,
    y = y_outcome,
    importance = TRUE,
    ntree = 2000
  )
  
  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  # Select top 10 variables
  n_select <- min(10, nrow(importance_df))
  selected_combined <- importance_df$Variable[1:n_select]
  
  vsurf_threshold <- selected_combined
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_combined
  vsurf_prediction <- selected_combined[1:min(5, length(selected_combined))]
  
  cat("FALLBACK SELECTION (top", n_select, "by importance):\n")
  print(head(importance_df, n_select), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
} else {
  
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold <- names(X_combined)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X_combined)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction <- names(X_combined)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]
  
  cat("VSURF RESULTS:\n\n")
  
  cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING (", length(vsurf_threshold), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    cat("  Variables passing relevance threshold:\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables passed threshold\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION (", length(vsurf_interpretation), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
    cat("  → USE THESE for explanatory model\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables selected for interpretation\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION (", length(vsurf_prediction), " variables):\n", sep = "")
  if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
    cat("  Minimal set for pure prediction:\n")
    for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) {
      cat("    ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠ No variables selected for prediction\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Variable importance from final RF
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_vals <- vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(X_combined)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres],
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))
    
    cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (threshold step - top 20):\n")
    print(head(importance_df, 20), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  } else {
    # If no variables passed threshold, get importance from raw data
    set.seed(12345)
    rf_model <- randomForest(
      x = X_combined,
      y = y_outcome,
      importance = TRUE,
      ntree = 2000
    )
    
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))
    
    cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (from initial RF - top 20):\n")
    print(head(importance_df, 20), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# E. Create final variable set
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART E: Creating final variable set\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Selected variables (interpretation set)
selected_combined <- vsurf_interpretation

# Handle case where VSURF selected nothing
if(length(selected_combined) == 0) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: VSURF selected 0 variables\n")
  cat("   Using top 10 from importance rankings as fallback\n\n")
  selected_combined <- importance_df$Variable[1:min(10, nrow(importance_df))]
}

# Classify by domain
selected_personality <- selected_combined[selected_combined %in% available_personality]
selected_clinical <- selected_combined[selected_combined %in% available_clinical]

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FINAL VARIABLE SET (COMBINED VSURF)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("TOTAL SELECTED:", length(selected_combined), "\n\n")

cat("PERSONALITY (", length(selected_personality), "):\n", sep = "")
if(length(selected_personality) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(selected_personality)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_personality[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("  ⚠ No personality variables selected\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("CLINICAL (", length(selected_clinical), "):\n", sep = "")
if(length(selected_clinical) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(selected_clinical)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_clinical[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("  ⚠ No clinical variables selected\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("Sample size:", nrow(X_combined), "\n")
cat("Events per variable:", round(min(outcome_table) / length(selected_combined), 1), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# F. Compare to separate VSURF results
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART F: Comparison to separate VSURF approach\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load separate VSURF results
vsurf_pers_separate <- readRDS("VSURF_results.rds")
vsurf_clin_separate <- readRDS("VSURF_clinical_results.rds")

separate_personality <- vsurf_pers_separate$personality_selected
separate_clinical <- vsurf_clin_separate$clinical_selected

cat("COMPARISON:\n\n")
cat("APPROACH 1 - SEPARATE VSURF (Primary Analysis):\n")
cat("  Personality selected:", length(separate_personality), "\n")
cat("  Clinical selected:", length(separate_clinical), "\n")
cat("  TOTAL:", length(separate_personality) + length(separate_clinical), "\n\n")

cat("APPROACH 2 - COMBINED VSURF (Sensitivity Analysis):\n")
cat("  Personality selected:", length(selected_personality), "\n")
cat("  Clinical selected:", length(selected_clinical), "\n")
cat("  TOTAL:", length(selected_combined), "\n\n")

# Overlap analysis
overlap_personality <- intersect(selected_personality, separate_personality)
overlap_clinical <- intersect(selected_clinical, separate_clinical)

cat("OVERLAP IN SELECTIONS:\n")
cat("  Personality: ", length(overlap_personality), " of ", 
    length(union(selected_personality, separate_personality)), " total unique\n", sep = "")
if(length(overlap_personality) > 0) {
  cat("    Both methods selected:", paste(overlap_personality, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("  Clinical: ", length(overlap_clinical), " of ", 
    length(union(selected_clinical, separate_clinical)), " total unique\n", sep = "")
if(length(overlap_clinical) > 0) {
  cat("    Both methods selected:", paste(overlap_clinical, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
cat("\n")

# Overall agreement
all_separate <- c(separate_personality, separate_clinical)
all_overlap <- intersect(selected_combined, all_separate)
agreement_rate <- length(all_overlap) / length(union(selected_combined, all_separate))

cat("OVERALL AGREEMENT:\n")

cat("  Agreement rate:", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * agreement_rate), "\n\n")

      selected_combined %in% adverse_vars ~ "Adverse Effects",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(Domain, Subdomain, Variable)
  
  domain_summary <- combined_groups %>%
    count(Domain, Subdomain, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    arrange(Domain, desc(N_Selected))
  
  cat("Selection breakdown:\n")
  print(domain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("Detailed listing:\n")
  for(domain in unique(combined_groups$Domain)) {
    cat("\n", domain, " VARIABLES:\n", sep = "")
    domain_vars <- combined_groups %>% filter(Domain == domain)
    for(subdomain in unique(domain_vars$Subdomain)) {
      subdomain_vars <- domain_vars %>% filter(Subdomain == subdomain)
      cat("  ", subdomain, " (", nrow(subdomain_vars), "):\n", sep = "")
      for(i in 1:nrow(subdomain_vars)) {
        cat("    • ", subdomain_vars$Variable[i], "\n", sep = "")
      }
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠ No variables to summarize\n\n")

  combined_groups <- data.frame()
}
```
